coreEssence: Fluid, luminous, editorial luxury moving between Persian depth and warm Porcelain, animated by confident magenta, turquoise and gold, with human warmth, visual intelligence and St Mary's House used only as selective provenance.
recognitionHierarchy: layered Champagne wave and fluid motion language
Persian depth balanced by Porcelain lift
editorial composition with rich, useful explanation
interactive visual teaching and refined medical intelligence

fixedColourIdentity.rule: These are real participating brand colours, not apologetic micro-accents. Their dosage varies by composition; their identity must not be replaced or washed away.

persian.role: depth, drama, velvet luminosity and authority

porcelain.role: warm lift, editorial breathing space, clarity and tactile lightness
constraints: must not become generic white SaaS
must retain wave, material, colour or editorial lineage

environmentDNA.balanceRule: Champagne is not a permanently dark site and not a pale minimal site. Persian and Porcelain form a deliberately varied rhythm.

waveAndSurfaceDNA.description: Large layered waves, fine contour lines, dotted fields, translucent mineral texture, currents, orbits and luminous transitions provide the primary visual grammar.
waveAndSurfaceDNA.constraint: A wave background alone may be loved yet still be insufficient as a complete Hero. Composition, interaction and narrative layering must complete it.

desired: editorial rhythm rather than uniform component stacking
alternation of deep and light chapters
large visual gestures balanced with calm reading areas
mixing compatible component families instead of forcing one repeated template
compositionDNA.guardrail: Approval of multiple section types authorises a curated rhythm, not use of all types on every page.

contentAndIntelligenceDNA.rule: Champagne luxury includes clarity, intelligence and usefulness; it is not decorative emptiness.

humanWarmthDNA.role: Essential counterweight to clinical precision and cinematic depth
humanWarmthDNA.constraint: Generic glamour photography and invented people are not substitutes for genuine warmth.

heritageAndPlaceDNA.subject: The real St Mary's House
approvedUses: wave-and-place bridge in the right position

heroDNA.knownCorrection: The Persian blue in the recorded reference is not yet the exact final Persian.

footerDNA.desired: A layered closing environment with a Porcelain-to-Persian descent or refined spectrum ember lineage, visually related to Hero V2 rather than a generic blue-and-gold footer.

conciergeVisualBoundary.positiveRequirement: A useful, highly interactive Concierge born from the same Champagne wave, editorial and visual-intelligence system.
rejected: sticky utility tray as the primary identity
invented building, bell or tooth emblem as a proxy for identity

antiDNA: dark grey as the primary dark environment
generic SaaS blockiness and repetitive card grids
ordinary chatbot or hotel-service Concierge language
generic polished dental CGI without Champagne lineage
Porcelain treated as bland white space
technical impressiveness mistaken for brand approval
founderJudgementRule: Machine alignment reports and derived profiles assist critique; they never replace explicit Founder judgement.
